units.source_text: 每逢源氏宿在别处的日子，紫夫人总是深夜不眠，和众侍女读小说，讲故事。

en.t: Whenever Genji spent the night elsewhere, Lady Murasaki would stay awake late into the night, reading romances and telling stories with her waiting women.

units.source_text: 就寝后她想：“这种描写种种世态的小说故事中，有浮薄男子、好色者，以及爱上了二心男子的女人，记述着他们的种种情节。

en.t: After going to bed, she thought, "In these tales that depict all kinds of worldly affairs, there are frivolous men, libertines, and women who fall in love with men of divided hearts, and their many circumstances are recorded.

units.source_text: 但结果每个女子总是归附一个男子，生活遂得安定。

en.t: Yet in the end each woman always attaches herself to one man, and her life becomes settled.

units.source_text: 只有我的境遇奇怪，一直是沉浮飘荡，不得安宁。

en.t: Only my situation is strange; I have always drifted through rises and falls, never finding peace.

units.source_text: 固如源氏主君所说，我的命运比别人幸福。

en.t: It is true, as Lord Genji says, that my fate is happier than other people's.

units.source_text: 然而，难道叫我终身怀抱了人所难堪的忧愁苦闷而死去么？

en.t: And yet, am I to die after carrying unbearable sorrow and anguish in my heart all my life?

units.source_text: 啊，太乏味了！”

en.t: Ah, how empty it all is!"

units.source_text: 她左思右想，直到夜深方才睡着。

en.t: She turned the matter over and over in her mind, and only fell asleep when the night had grown deep.

units.source_text: 破晓醒来，觉得胸中难过。

en.t: When she woke at daybreak, she felt pain and distress in her chest.

units.source_text: 众侍女着了急，都说：“快去通报大人！”

en.t: The waiting women became alarmed and all said, "Go quickly and inform his lordship!"

units.source_text: 紫夫人拦阻道：“不可去通报！”

en.t: Lady Murasaki stopped them, saying, "You must not go and tell him!"

units.source_text: 便忍着痛苦，直到天明。

en.t: So she endured the pain until dawn.

units.source_text: 此时身体发烧，心地异常恶劣。

en.t: By then her body was feverish, and she felt terribly ill.

units.source_text: 但是源氏还不归来，无法使他知道。

en.t: But Genji still had not returned, and there was no way to let him know.

units.source_text: 恰好明石女御派人送封信来，

en.t: Just then, the Akashi Empress sent someone with a letter,

units.source_text: 侍女们便回复他说：“夫人今晨忽然患病了。”

en.t: and the waiting women replied to the messenger, "Her ladyship suddenly fell ill this morning."

units.source_text: 明石女御得复，吃了一惊，便派人去报知源氏。

en.t: When the Akashi Empress received the reply, she was startled and sent someone to inform Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏闻讯，心如刀割，急忙回家，

en.t: When Genji heard the news, his heart felt as if it had been cut by a knife, and he hurried home,

units.source_text: 但见紫夫人病得非常痛苦。

en.t: only to find Lady Murasaki suffering terribly from her illness.

units.source_text: 便问：“你现在觉得怎么样？”

en.t: He asked, "How are you feeling now?"

units.source_text: 同时伸手摸她身体，觉得热度甚高。

en.t: At the same time he reached out and touched her body, and found that her fever was very high.

units.source_text: 他回想起昨天所说消灾延寿祈祷之事，

en.t: He remembered what had been said the day before about prayers to avert disaster and prolong life,

units.source_text: 心中异常惊恐。

en.t: and he was filled with extraordinary fear.

units.source_text: 侍女们把源氏的早粥送进房间里来，

en.t: The waiting women brought Genji's morning rice gruel into the room,

units.source_text: 但他看也不看一眼。

en.t: but he would not even glance at it.

units.source_text: 这一天他整日在房中看护，调度一切，愁眉不展。

en.t: That day he stayed in the room all day nursing her, directing everything, his brow clouded with worry.
